package fx

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// The test prints secrets the way a careless test might: a credential-shaped
// literal and the value of a secret environment variable.
func TestLeaksSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("aws key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP")
	t.Log("env token " + os.Getenv("CHECKREPORT_CANARY_TOKEN"))
	t.Fatal("boom")
}
